# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 development**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 advances to Skia m156 with expanded GTK4 and Tizen support. It restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and aligns native assets with current .NET and platform toolchains.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and incorporates the m155 core-fork cleanup. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208), [#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again discover installed system fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **GTK4 gains native GPU rendering** — GTK4 applications can use native GPU rendering with pixel scaling support. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Tizen 10 native builds updated** — Updates Tizen packaging and native builds for the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **.NET 11 preview assets aligned** — Updates .NET preview pins and WebAssembly native assets to keep upcoming .NET consumers aligned. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

Updates HarfBuzzSharp build alignment for .NET 11 preview assets, current Windows toolchains, and Tizen 10 packaging.
